No Apple Health weight received yet.

Set up daily sync · four actions

Install Worker 5.13 first. Create one private sync link, then build the four actions below in Apple Shortcuts.

This link can submit weights only. Keep it private. Creating another link replaces the previous one.

Create a shortcut named NONZERO Weight Sync:

  1. Find Health Samples — Type: Weight; Sort: Start Date, Latest First; Limit: 1. Remove any default date filter.
  2. Format Date — use Health Samples, tap the variable and select its Start Date. Format: ISO 8601.
  3. Text — copy the template below. Replace REPLACE_WITH_WEIGHT with the Health Samples variable, then tap it and choose Value. Replace REPLACE_WITH_DATE with Formatted Date.
  4. Get Contents of URL — paste your private sync link; Method: POST; Request Body: File; choose the Text action as the file. No headers or JSON fields. 
weight=REPLACE_WITH_WEIGHT
measuredAt=REPLACE_WITH_DATE
unit=lb

The template uses pounds. If Health displays numeric weights in kilograms, change the last line to unit=kg.

Schedule it: Add a Time of Day automation to this shortcut: 10:00 a.m. → Daily → Run Immediately (turn off Ask Before Running if shown). On newer Shortcuts versions, add the trigger under the shortcut's Edit → Automation. This schedule is set on your iPhone; NONZERO cannot create or confirm it from this webpage.

Test once: Run the shortcut while unlocked and allow Weight access and the network request. Then tap Check imported weight here. After that, the time trigger runs it without a Withings app action.

Important iPhone limit: allowing the shortcut to run while locked does not guarantee access to protected Health data. If iOS blocks the 10 a.m. read, the run needs to be retried while unlocked. There is no guaranteed new-weight event trigger in this free setup.

Repeated readings are skipped without another state write. The reading keeps its original date. No Withings developer account, subscription or Pi update is required.

Ride controls

Switch views, choose your scene, or start the soundtrack. Your workout keeps running.

Adaptive soundtrack

Tap Soundtrack on · phone to hear the original scene score through your phone or connected speaker.

The rhythm follows cadence; each landscape has its own musical palette. Phone cadence updates arrive about every 15 seconds; TV audio follows the PM5 directly. Choose one output to avoid an echo. Phone audio pauses when the app is hidden or the workout is paused. If no live cadence arrives, the phone uses a steady tempo. TV audio requires an enabled Pi audio output. This original instrumental does not control Amazon Music.
